mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cso_header ( id, doc_no, company, store, customer_code, customer_branch, customer_email, supplier_code, supplier_contract, auto_generate_csdo, note, status, created_by, created_method, reference_no, shipping_term, delivery_date, shipping_mode, transporter, shipping_to, shipping_address, customer_reference, transport_information, released_at, released_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{docNo}, #{company}, #{store}, #{customerCode}, #{customerBranch}, #{customerEmail}, #{supplierCode}, #{supplierContract}, #{autoGenerateCsdo}, #{note}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdMethod}, #{referenceNo}, #{shippingTerm}, #{deliveryDate}, #{shippingMode}, #{transporter}, #{shippingTo}, #{shippingAddress}, #{customerReference}, #{transportInformation}, #{releasedAt}, #{releasedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO cso_detail (id, cso_id, item_code, qty, uom) VALUES (#{id}, #{csoId}, #{itemCode}, #{qty}, #{uom})
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_no, company, store, customer_code, customer_branch, customer_email, supplier_code, supplier_contract, auto_generate_csdo, note, status, created_by, created_method, reference_no, shipping_term, delivery_date, shipping_mode, transporter, shipping_to, shipping_address, customer_reference, transport_information, released_at, released_by, created_at, updated_at FROM cso_header WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT h.id, h.doc_no, h.company, h.store, h.customer_code, h.customer_branch, h.customer_email, h.supplier_code, h.supplier_contract, h.auto_generate_csdo, h.note, h.status, h.created_by, h.created_method, h.reference_no, h.shipping_term, h.delivery_date, h.shipping_mode, h.transporter, h.shipping_to, h.shipping_address, h.customer_reference, h.transport_information, h.released_at, h.released_by, h.created_at, h.updated_at FROM cso_header h LEFT JOIN cso_detail d ON d.cso_id = h.id
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{c.perPage} OFFSET #{c.offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) FROM cso_header h LEFT JOIN cso_detail d ON d.cso_id = h.id
SELECT id, cso_id, item_code, qty, uom FROM cso_detail WHERE cso_id = #{csoId} ORDER BY item_code ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE cso_header SET status = #{status}, released_at = #{releasedAt}, released_by = #{releasedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(doc_no FROM 5) AS BIGINT)), 0) FROM cso_header WHERE doc_no ~ '^CSO-[0-9]+$'
mapper.update: UPDATE cso_header SET customer_branch = #{customerBranch}, customer_email = #{customerEmail}, note = #{note}, reference_no = #{referenceNo}, shipping_term = #{shippingTerm}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate}, shipping_mode = #{shippingMode}, transporter = #{transporter}, shipping_to = #{shippingTo}, shipping_address = #{shippingAddress}, customer_reference = #{customerReference}, transport_information = #{transportInformation}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
